analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI entered oversold territory, and MACD histogram continued to worsen. The 5-day low was renewed, strengthening the bearish pattern. ADX at 30.0 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (31.9) significantly exceeds the +DI (13.1), showing downward pressure dominance. The 4-hour MACD histogram also worsened to -9.3901. Current price $2,224 is near the swing support at $2,221.22. With ATR at $87.66, setting stop loss at 1.0-4.0x ATR results in excessive entry risk. No bullish reversal signals are present.
